Care instructions

Our rugs need only regular care to last: periodic vacuuming, and turning the rug now and then so wear falls evenly across the pile. Blot spills immediately with a dry cloth, and lift stains with a detergent made for wool. For anything large, oily or already dry, use a professional rug cleaner.
